name: The Student
description: Years of preparing for civil service exams collide with a verdict that reinstates the quotas she thought were gone. What starts as a campus petition becomes a choice she can't take back.

name: The Journalist
description: Her job is to be where the story is — even when that means standing between a lens and a line of riot police. Every day asks the same question: how close is too close?

name: The Rickshaw-puller
description: The blockades that make the news are the roads he depends on to feed his family. As the city shuts down around him, every day is a choice between safety and a day's earnings.
